No enlarged lower detail, no duplicate image, no extra isometric, no new domed towers at joins, no new rear buildings, no relocation of wings. sheets.title: Ground wall, L1 arrival terrace and gate-wall setback
sheets.prompt:
Draw a precise architectural engineering SKETCH SHEET, pure overhead FLOOR PLAN above and a simple longitudinal SIDE SECTION below. Title: PAL-ENTRY-001 — Level 1 entrance and gate-wall setback. TWO views ONLY. No isometric, no perspective, no third view, no facade elevation inside the plan. Use fine black technical linework on ivory paper, pale rose fill for solid masonry, light blue for water; restrained decorative motif on wall footprint only. The supplied palace image is a motif reference and a five-bay wall reference, NOT a camera to copy. This task is about depth spacing, not pretty rendered architecture.
UPPER PANEL — TRUE PLAN, looking exactly vertically down. North/rear at TOP, south/front at BOTTOM. Three parallel HORIZONTAL datum lines from left to right: TOP line Y=0, gate wall; MIDDLE line Y=-75, stair top; BOTTOM line Y=-150, front retaining wall/stair foot. These three horizontal lines are vertically spaced EQUALLY on the page. Draw one SINGLE thick connected gate-wall FOOTPRINT on the TOP datum Y=0. It has five labelled shallow openings across its WIDTH: G1 G2 G3 G4 G5, centre G3 arrival doorway and four glazed window wall apertures indicated by thin blue lines. Labels are just above their footprint openings. Do not draw front-facing arches, stained-glass elevations or towers in this overhead plan. Draw attached unequal wing FOOTPRINTS on left and right, continuously joining this top gate wall; use rounded/chamfered returns and source-inspired terrace outlines. These lateral proposed footprints must not move the gate datum. The middle-to-top band Y=-75 to Y=0 is a large open L1 ARRIVAL TERRACE, labelled 75 GRID m DEEP; keep a broad central dry path to G3, gardens and small round fountain footprints only at SIDE edges. Draw the FRONT retaining wall footprint along bottom Y=-150, continuing on either side of a wide central U-SHAPED NOTCH. Within that notch, draw TWO clearly hatched dry stair strips flanking a CENTRAL blue stepped water cascade, extending from BOTTOM Y=-150 to MIDDLE Y=-75. Small arrows on stair strips point north/up. Stair strips and cascade STOP at the middle datum, not at the gate wall. A narrow blue channel on the terrace is optional but must not block dry access or G3. Draw all small plants/benches/lamps as TRUE plan marks, not upright objects. NO domed tower elevations in plan. Important dimensions placed at the RIGHT side of plan, with VERTICAL arrows aligned to north-south depth: ONE overall 150 GRID m arrow from bottom Y=-150 to top Y=0; alongside it TWO consecutive 75 GRID m arrows, bottom-to-middle and middle-to-top. Dimension arrows must be VERTICAL on this panel, never across the wall's width. Label terrace height Z=60; ground at stair foot Z=0. Leave width undimensioned, since exact widths and hidden wing footprints are proposals.
LOWER PANEL — TRUE LONGITUDINAL SIDE SECTION through a dry stair route to the central gate, SOUTH/FRONT on LEFT, NORTH/REAR on RIGHT. Show ONLY the side-cut shell and stair, not five frontal arches. Three Y stations LEFT-TO-RIGHT equally spaced: Y=-150 at LEFT (stair foot Z=0), Y=-75 at CENTRE (stair top Z=60), Y=0 at RIGHT (gate wall base Z=60). Draw an ascending stepped stair line from the LEFT ground point to the CENTRE terrace point. Then a FLAT HORIZONTAL terrace line from CENTRE to RIGHT at Z=60: this is the clear 75 GRID m terrace between the stair top and the gate. Put the SINGLE thin vertical gate-wall side-cut at the RIGHT station Y=0, rising from Z=60 to Z=160. Do not put the gate at CENTRE or at the stair top. Below the whole stair and terrace span, draw ONE 150 GRID m HORIZONTAL dimension arrow LEFT-to-RIGHT, and TWO consecutive 75 GRID m arrows LEFT-to-CENTRE and CENTRE-to-RIGHT. Draw separate vertical height arrows: 60 GRID m ground-to-terrace, 100 GRID m gate-wall rise above the terrace. Label ground Z=0, terrace Z=60, gate wall top Z=160. Masonry below terrace is continuous retaining base except the stair arrival notch. Show actual cut hatching, a side-view threshold at the gate and a short roof/interior line beyond Y=0. Do NOT draw stained-glass front elevations in this side section.
Small footer: Design grid m; world scale ×2.75. Front wall to gate 150 m; stair top to gate 75 m. Wing depth/width proposed. GEN-37 controls front appearance. Crisp clear geometric drawing, ample white space, legible datum labels and exactly aligned plan/section distances. This is a dimensioned proposed layout, not a measured model. Avoid ornamental complexity that compromises the parallel datums and two equal consecutive depth bands.
